json_ld_descriptions: Karlin, Fleisher & Falkenberg, LLC is a Chicago trial-hardened powerhouse focusing on catastrophic personal injury and medical malpractice litigation. The Firm has been trusted since 1970 with over $600 million recovered for clients across medical malpractice, nursing home abuse, wrongful death, and motor vehicle accident type cases. Their courtroom and mediation reputation is built on monumental outcomes, including a $17.2 million recovery in a construction paralysis case, $17.75 million in a Utility explosion, $7.5 million for a Medical malpractice post-delivery case, $6.2 million in a carbon monoxide poisoning case and a $6.2 million settlement in a birth injury involving cerebral palsy, as well as a record-setting Cook County products liability award of $3.6 million. Led by acclaimed attorneys Charles V. Falkenberg III and Jonathan B. Fleisher who have been recognized with distinctions such as Illinois Super Lawyer, inclusion in the Million- and Multi-Million-Dollar Advocates Forums, Best of the Best Attorney, Leading Lawyer, and Who’s Who in the World. The law firm has received the highest peer review rating of AV based on legal abilities and ethical standards. The firm pairs deep trial experience with relentless advocacy. Offering free consultations and working on a contingent fee basis, they blend Chicago grit with legal mastery to deliver full compensation and justice when that’s what matters most.
